content.title: Knicks vs Warriors Game Notes: March 4, 2025 | New York Knicks
content.text: The Knicks will tip off against the Golden State Warriors at 7:30PM ET at Madison Square Garden. (MSG NETWORK/TNT; RADIO: 880 AM ESPN)This Day in Knicks History:March 4, 1993: Doc Rivers ties a franchise record for most assists without a single turnover (14) in a 125-111 victory over the Utah Jazz at Madison Square Garden. Last game played vs Golden State:Golden State (03/18/24) – The Knicks extend their winning streak to four by defeating the Warriors 119-112. Jalen Brunson recorded a game-high 34 points, seven assists, five rebounds, and one steal. Josh Hart recorded his fifth triple-double of the season by tallying 11 rebounds, 11 assists, and 10 points. Miles McBride registered 29 points on 66.7 percent shooting, six made three-pointers, two assists, and one steal. The Warriors were paced by Stephen Curry who recorded a team-high 27 points, five rebounds, and five assists. Jonathan Kuminga registered 16 points on 53.8 percent shooting, one rebound, one assist, and steal. Trayce Jackson-Davis came off the bench and had 19 points, nine rebounds, two assists, and three blocks.Connections: Warriors guard Stephen Curry scored a career-high 54 points in a loss against the Knicks on February 27, 2013 at Madison Square Garden. Curry also broke Reggie Miller’s record for most three-pointers made in a career on December 14, 2021 at Madison Square Garden. Tom Thibodeau coached Warriors general manager Mike Dunleavy Jr. for two seasons on the Chicago Bulls (2013-15). Warriors forward Jimmy Butler played for Thibodeau for six seasons in Chicago (2011-15) and Minnesota (2017-19). Butler was also teammates with Knicks center Karl-Anthony Towns with Knicks assistant Andy Greer having been the assistant coach on those teams. Knicks guard Cam Payne and Warriors forward Buddy Hield were teammates in Philadelphia last season. Knicks guard Josh Hart and Warriors guard Gary Payton II were teammates on the Los Angeles Lakers in 2018 and the Portland Trail Blazers during part of the 2023- 24 season. Knicks assistant coach Darren Erman served as an assistant coach on the Warriors for three seasons (2011-14). Warriors television analyst Kelenna Azubuike was traded by the Warriors along with Anthony Randolph, Ronny Turiaf, a 2012 2nd round draft pick and a 2013 2nd round draft pick to the New York Knicks for David Lee (July 9, 2010). Warriors forward Kevin Knox II was drafted ninth overall by the Knicks in the 2018 NBA Draft.center Kel’el Ware both attended Indiana University.Last game played:Miami (03/02/25) – The New York Knicks defeated the Miami Heat, 116-112. Jalen Brunson led New York with 31 points, six assists, five rebounds and two steals. OG Anunoby recorded 23 points, nine rebounds, five assists, three blocks and two steals. Karl-Anthony Towns collected 19 points, 16 rebounds and one block. Miami was led by Bam Adebayo’s 30 points, seven rebounds, four assists and one steal. Tyler Herro scored 22 points, seven assists and four rebounds. Kel’el Ware added 12 points, eight rebounds and six blocksON A HEATER - BRUNSON LEADS KNICKS OVER MIAMI IN OT:Jalen Brunson recorded 31 points, six assists, five rebounds and two steals. This marks his 20th game of the season recording 30+ points and at least five or more assists, which is tied with Nikola Jokic for second in the NBA. It also marked his 74th 30+ point game with the Knicks, which is ranked fourth in franchise history.Karl-Anthony Towns recorded 19 points, 16 rebounds and one block. This marks his 22nd 15 point-15 rebound game of the season, which is ranked first in the NBA. Towns’ 44th double-double of the season is ranked second in the NBA.OG Anunoby recorded 23 points, nine rebounds, five assists, three blocks and two steals. This marks his first career game scoring 20+ points, at least five or more rebounds, at least five or more assists, and multiple blocks and steals. Mikal Bridges recorded a season-high eight assists. Miles McBride recorded his 250th career three-pointer.The Knicks are now 10-0 in their last “clutch games” and 5-0 in overtime this season. Their 19-point comeback at Miami marks their largest of the season.Next Opponent: Los Angeles Lakers - Thurs, Mar. 6th • 10:00PM ET
